variables.name: action_creates_hr_case
variables.description: Candidate tool call creates a new HR case record (e.g. create_new_hr_case).

variables.name: action_short_desc_invalid_length
variables.description: Candidate call supplies a short_description argument whose character length is below 30 or above 120, or omits it on a case-creation call.

variables.name: action_priority_invalid
variables.description: Candidate call supplies an hr_case priority value that is not one of critical, high, medium, low.

variables.name: action_case_state_not_new
variables.description: Candidate case-creation call supplies an initial state argument other than 'new'.

variables.name: context_service_active_verified
variables.description: A prior successful lookup in the trajectory (e.g. find_hr_services/get_hr_service_by_name) returned the exact hr_service referenced by the candidate call and showed it as active.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_closed
variables.description: Candidate call sets an hr_case state to 'closed'.

variables.name: context_case_state_resolved
variables.description: A prior successful read of the targeted hr_case in this trajectory shows its current state is 'resolved'.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_resolved
variables.description: Candidate call sets an hr_case state to 'resolved'.

variables.name: context_case_tasks_complete
variables.description: Prior successful reads of the targeted case's hr_case_task records show every mandatory task has active = false or state = closed.

variables.name: action_changes_case_state
variables.description: Candidate call changes the state field of an existing hr_case.

variables.name: context_case_state_canceled
variables.description: A prior successful read of the targeted hr_case shows its current state is 'canceled'.

variables.name: action_assigns_user
variables.description: Candidate call sets an assigned_to user on an hr_case or hr_case_task together with an assignment_group.

variables.name: context_assignee_active_group_member
variables.description: Prior successful lookups (e.g. get_user, list_group_members) show the assigned_to user is active and is a current member of the specified assignment_group.

variables.name: action_approves_or_rejects
variables.description: Candidate call approves or rejects an hr_approval record.

variables.name: context_actor_role_manager_or_admin
variables.description: Evidence in the request or prior successful system reads establishes the acting user's role as hr_manager/manager or administrator.

variables.name: action_task_type_invalid
variables.description: Candidate call supplies an hr_case_task type value outside: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge_article
variables.description: Candidate call links a knowledge article to a case (case_knowledge).

variables.name: context_article_published
variables.description: A prior successful read (e.g. retrieve_knowledge_articles) shows the linked article's state is 'published'.

variables.name: action_updates_profile_restricted_field
variables.description: Candidate call updates an hr_profile field other than address or phone.

variables.name: context_actor_is_employee_self
variables.description: Evidence shows the acting user holds the employee role and the targeted hr_profile is the acting user's own profile.

variables.name: context_case_or_approval_authorizes_update
variables.description: A prior successful observation shows an HR case or an hr_approval record with status approved covering the requested profile change.

variables.name: action_discloses_pii_external
variables.description: Candidate call sends PII/PHI field values (e.g. national_id, bank_account, health_record_id) through an outbound channel such as email, chat or notification message.

variables.name: action_modifies_user_or_config
variables.description: Candidate call creates/updates/deactivates core user data (login/role), groups, roles, skills, assignment rules, services, templates or other system configuration tables.

variables.name: context_actor_role_administrator
variables.description: Evidence in the request or prior successful system reads establishes the acting user's role as administrator.

variables.name: action_sets_short_text_field
variables.description: Candidate call supplies a short description, title, brief note, resolution summary or escalation reason text field.

variables.name: action_short_text_invalid_length
variables.description: A supplied short description, title, brief note, resolution summary or escalation reason is shorter than 30 or longer than 120 characters.

variables.name: action_role_value_invalid
variables.description: Candidate call supplies a user.role value outside: administrator, hr_manager, hr_specialist, employee.

rules.title: Case must reference an active HR service
rules.rationale: New cases must point to a verified active service record.
rules.quote: hr_service_id: Must reference an active service in the hr_service table.
rules.remediation: Look up the referenced hr_service and confirm it is active before creating the case.

rules.title: Case short_description must be 30-120 chars
rules.quote: short_description: Must adhere to free-form text policies (30-120 chars).
rules.remediation: Supply a short_description between 30 and 120 characters identifying service, subject and detail.

rules.title: Priority must use allowed values
rules.rationale: Non-listed enum values cause INVALID_ENUM_VALUE errors.
rules.quote: hr_case.priority allowed values: critical, high, medium, low.
rules.remediation: Use critical, high, medium or low, or omit priority.

rules.title: New cases start in state new
rules.rationale: Policy fixes the initial case state.
rules.quote: Default State: All new cases are set to state = new.
rules.remediation: Create the case with state = new and transition it afterwards.

rules.title: Close only from resolved
rules.rationale: Direct closure from other states is forbidden.
rules.quote: A case cannot transition directly from any state to closed. It must first reach resolved state.
rules.remediation: Move the case to resolved first, then close it.

rules.title: No transitions out of canceled
rules.quote: canceled is a final state; no further transitions allowed.
rules.remediation: Do not change the state of a canceled case; open a new case instead.

rules.title: Resolve only after mandatory tasks complete
rules.quote: An HR Case cannot move to state = resolved until all mandatory hr_case_task.active = false (completed) or hr_case_task.state = closed.
rules.remediation: Complete or close all mandatory fulfillment tasks before resolving the case.

rules.title: Assignee must be active group member
rules.quote: The assigned_to user must be active and a current member of the specified assignment_group.
rules.remediation: Verify the user is active and a member of the assignment group before assigning.

rules.title: Only managers or administrators approve
rules.rationale: Approval authority is restricted by role.
rules.quote: Only users with role = manager or role = administrator may approve or reject records.
rules.remediation: Route the approval to an HR Manager or Administrator.

rules.title: Task type must be in enumeration
rules.rationale: Only listed task types are valid.
rules.quote: Task types are limited to the enumeration: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.
rules.remediation: Use one of the listed task types.

rules.title: Link only published articles
rules.quote: Only articles in knowledge.state = published are visible and linkable.
rules.remediation: Confirm the article's state is published before linking it to a case.

rules.title: Employee self-updates limited to address and phone
rules.rationale: Other self-service profile changes need a case or approved approval record.
rules.quote: Employees can only update limited fields on their own profile (address, phone). All other updates require an HR Case or an approved hr_approval record.
rules.remediation: Register an HR Case or obtain an approved hr_approval record for the requested field change.

rules.title: Never disclose PII/PHI on public channels
rules.rationale: PII/PHI must stay inside secured internal UI.
rules.quote: Do not disclose PII or PHI fields via any public channel (email, chat response) even if authorized.
rules.remediation: Omit PII/PHI values from outbound messages; reference the record instead.

rules.title: User/config changes require administrator
rules.rationale: Specialists and managers may not modify core user data or system configuration.
rules.quote: Restrictions: Cannot modify core user data (login/role), approval records, or system configuration tables.
rules.remediation: Escalate system configuration or user/role changes to an Administrator.

rules.title: Short text fields 30-120 characters
rules.quote: Character Limits: Minimum 30 characters, Maximum 120 characters for all short descriptions, titles, and brief notes.
rules.remediation: Rewrite the text to be between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: user.role must use allowed values
rules.rationale: Only listed role values are valid.
rules.quote: user.role allowed values: administrator, hr_manager, hr_specialist, employee.
rules.remediation: Use administrator, hr_manager, hr_specialist or employee.

inventory.quote: Do not generate or fabricate record IDs or data fields.
inventory.reason: Fabrication cannot be judged from the call alone without system state.

inventory.quote: Do not ask for any information or confirmation from the user.
inventory.reason: Concerns conversational behavior, not tool calls.

inventory.quote: Atomic Operations: Perform one distinct operation at a time, unless utilizing a pre-approved batch processing utility.
inventory.reason: No observable per-call property distinguishes chained operations.

Template: "Resolution Guide: fulfillment steps for ".

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the proposed tool call against the HR Management Assistant Policy. Check: referenced hr_service is active; short_description and other short text fields are 30-120 chars; enum values (priority, task type, role, state) are allowed; case creation starts in state new; state transitions are legal (no direct close, resolve only after mandatory tasks complete, no transition out of canceled); assignments target an active user who belongs to the assignment group; approvals/rejections are performed by a manager or administrator; knowledge links reference published articles; employee self profile updates beyond address/phone have an HR case or approved approval; no PII/PHI values appear in outbound messages; user/role/system-configuration changes are performed by an administrator. Base judgement only on the request, policy defaults, prior successful observations and the candidate arguments; never on expected outcomes. Reads that change nothing must not be blocked.

approved.description: true if the call complies with the policy

extractor_format.instructions: For each fact, output true, false, or null (unknown) using only the candidate tool call arguments and prior trajectory evidence (request text, policy defaults, successful prior tool results). Action facts describe the candidate call only; value-constraint facts (invalid length, invalid enum) are true only when the offending value is actually present in the arguments and false when a conforming value is present. Context facts require an explicit earlier successful observation about the same actor, resource and purpose; a supplied identifier or an unverified claim is not evidence. Role facts must concern the acting user, not a target record. Never use the candidate call's result, hidden database state, or later events. If evidence is absent, use null and explain in evidence.
